Air India CEO-designate Secures Security Clearance, Outlines Strategy

Tewolde Gebremariam, the CEO-designate of Air India, has received security clearance. He has outlined five strategic priorities for the airline, emphasizing the need to keep costs under check while simultaneously working to raise revenue. Gebremariam stated that while external factors influence performance, Air India must maintain its focus on financial results. Safety and reliability have been identified as primary concerns within his strategic plan.
